title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1976-06-09
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Superb matrix recording of a very good show – highly recommended.
ai_review.review: The composite (matrix) source created by Hunter delivers a clear and balanced sound that showcases the performance nicely. Reviewers describe the concert as "very good" and urge listeners to give it a spin, though no specific songs or moments are called out.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; it praises both the matrix recording and the overall show, indicating a high quality performance and excellent technical capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Composite (matrix) mix described as beautiful and highly recommended; no reported issues with clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer calls the show "very good" but provides no detailed comments on set structure or specific moments.
